        acc'.push (a :: l'); bif L.any isEmpty then [] else (L.foldr go #[[]]).toList

exact let rec go : List Int → Nat → Array Int → List Int | [], _, acc => acc.toList | _::xs, 0, acc => xs.foldl (fun acc a => acc.push a) acc |>.toList | a :: as, n+1, acc => go as n (acc.push a); go as n #[]

exact let rec go : List Int → Nat → Array Int → List Int | [], _, acc => acc.toList | as, 0, acc => as.foldl (fun acc a => acc.push (a + a)) acc |>.toList | a :: as, k+1, acc => go as k (acc.push (a + a)); go as k #[]
